name: Uqua: Final Altar of the Ocean God
summary: The Ocean God’s shattered altar, where Discord ruptures overwhelm divine planar water and catastrophic instability reigns.
description: The Final Altar is the most dangerous chamber in Uqua. Once the sacred site of the Ocean God’s greatest rites, the altar has been shattered by Discord ruptures. Water rises in violent spirals, collapsing into voids and reforming unpredictably. Planar conduits overload, releasing destructive surges of divine and Discord energy. Ocean Cult high priests defend the altar with fanatical devotion, while Muramite forces attempt to seize its power. Discord manifestations erupt constantly, threatening total planar collapse. The Final Altar is a battleground of divine magic, catastrophic instability, and the last remnants of the Ocean God’s influence.
